title: Unique comparison normalized on functorial resolutions
statement: Let W be a morphism property on C, Q:C→D its localization, and q:Id_C→P a functorial replacement with every q_X in W (hence Q(q_X) invertible). Let O:C→H, S,T:D→H, and let κ:Q⋙T≅U be a specified model isomorphism. If α:O→Q⋙S and β:O→U have invertible components on every P(X), there is a unique natural isomorphism e:S≅T with α_X ≫ e_{Q(X)} ≫ κ_X = β_X for every X.

source.place: Tags 0D6E and 0941; agent-formulated normalization subargument of compact-support realization Step 11.

proof.text: Invert α at P(X), compose with β at P(X), and conjugate by S(Q(q_X)) and T(Q(q_X)). These component maps assemble as a natural isomorphism between Q⋙S and Q⋙T. Fully faithful precomposition with localization descends it to e.

Naturality of α and β along q_X cancels α at P(X) and gives the normalization equation at every X. For two normalized comparisons first cancel α at P(X), then use their naturality and cancel T(Q(q_X)); essential surjectivity of Q proves equality. For a specified model isomorphism κ, first replace β by β followed by κ inverse. Postcompose the resulting normalization by κ; cancelling κ proves equivalence of the two normalization predicates and preserves uniqueness.

proof_origin: G1: proved by fully faithful precomposition with localization, using functorial replacements and cancellation of a specified model isomorphism. No new sorry.

lean.statement:
theorem resolutionNormalizedComparison
    {C D H : Type*} [Category C] [Category D] [Category H]
    (Q : C ⥤ D) (W : MorphismProperty C) [Q.IsLocalization W]
    (P : C ⥤ C) (q : 𝟭 C ⟶ P) (hq : ∀ X, W (q.app X))
    (O : C ⥤ H) (S T : D ⥤ H) (U : C ⥤ H) (κ : Q ⋙ T ≅ U)
    (α : O ⟶ Q ⋙ S) (β : O ⟶ U)
    (hα : ∀ X, IsIso (α.app (P.obj X))) (hβ : ∀ X, IsIso (β.app (P.obj X))) :
    ∃! e : S ≅ T, ∀ X,
      α.app X ≫ e.hom.app (Q.obj X) ≫ κ.hom.app X = β.app X
